# PLG Content Calendar

## When to use
Calendars, posting plans, series, batch days, what to post this week.

## Procedure
1. Read content-calendar/14-day-plan.md and ugc-scripts/hook-scripts.md.
2. Do not rewrite the 14-day plan unless asked.
3. New work goes in `content-calendar/{n}-day-{focus}.md`.
4. Every row maps: Day | Hook | Format | Offer/CTA | Source file.
5. Reuse existing hooks before inventing new ones.
6. One CTA per day. Brand voice skill applies.

## Default offer
Suno track + @planlifegrateful + pack in bio.
